name: esg_score_tilt_renormalized_weights
question_template: A benchmark holds four stocks A, B, C and D with weights {W_A}%, {W_B}%, {W_C}% and the remainder to 100% in D (if that remainder is below 1% the benchmark is invalid). ESG scores on a 0-100 scale are A {S_A}, B {S_B}, C {S_C}, D {S_D}. An ESG tilt first computes the benchmark-weighted average score. Each stock's tilt factor is 1 + 2 x (its score minus that average)/100, but never below a floor of 0.25; the floor applies to the factor before renormalization. Multiply each benchmark weight by its factor, then renormalize the four tilted weights so they sum to 100%. Report the tilted weight of stock {TARGET} in percent. Also report the benchmark-weighted average ESG score, the tilted portfolio's weighted ESG score, and the active weight of stock {TARGET}, defined as tilted weight minus benchmark weight, in percentage points.

slots.description: Benchmark-weighted average ESG score on the 0-100 scale
Weighted ESG score of the renormalized tilted portfolio
Tilted weight minus benchmark weight of the target stock, percentage points
